Why It Moved

Every session since Apr 2024: was the rise knowable before the open, or chance? Tests chosen on data before Jul 2025, checked after

Of every liquid stock that beat the median by 5%+ in a session since 2025-07-01 (13,808): 5% validated before the open · 24% news during the session · 18% news before the open, no proven edge · 53% nothing on record. When a validated test fired before the open the stock was 3.05× as likely as any stock to be such a mover. 35 tests/pairs held up (luck alone gives 13).
